name: archive_mode
description: Enables archiving of completed WAL files using archive_command; required for point-in-time recovery and logical replication.
symptoms: Backup failures due to missing WAL archives
Inability to promote standby to primary during failover
Data loss beyond last base backup
tuning_tips: Enable 'on' for standard PITR and backups; use 'always' only when archiving is needed during standby recovery. Must be set before startup and requires wal_level >= 'replica'.
